description: This Java class 'MainResourceHandler' manages resource information and loading operations for configuration files within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles reading XML documents, obtaining resource URLs, and managing resource locations with support for custom loaders.

classes.name: MainResourceHandler
classes.description: A class that implements resource handling functionalities such as loading XML documents and resources based on configuration parameters, with support for custom loaders and location management.

methods.name: MainResourceHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with XML filename and XML element attributes 'loader' and 'location'.

methods.name: MainResourceHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with XML filename, loader name, and location strings.

methods.name: getLoaderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the loader associated with this resource.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location of the resource.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Reads and returns the XML Document from the resource, throwing exception on failure.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream to the resource, potentially throwing an exception.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Obtains the URL of the resource, throwing an exception if inaccessible.

methods.name: isFileResource
methods.description: Determines if the resource is a file resource based on the loader type.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Returns the full location path of the resource as determined by its loader.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on loaderName, xmlFilename, and location.
